Definition: to be (or become) pregnant, conceive (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: Harah means to conceive, and it carries the whole story of the promised seed from the first family to the first king's mother. In Genesis 4:1 Eve conceives Cain, in Genesis 16:4 Hagar conceives and despises her mistress, in Genesis 21:2 Sarah conceives Isaac in her old age, and in 1 Samuel 1:20 Hannah conceives Samuel after years of barrenness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is full of hope and full of trouble at once: conception brings the child of promise and the child of strife, and God works through both. Sarah laughed, Hannah wept, and God kept his word to each of them.
